card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer medical word split into parts, such as the IC in SUICIDAL, ar in antimalarials, or ura in purpura.

modes.label: Inside suicidality terms
modes.description: The IC piece in capitalized SUICIDAL or SUICIDALITY in warning headings.

modes.label: Inside drug class names
modes.description: The ar piece in antimalarials within lists of drug classes.

modes.label: Inside other clinical terms
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of words like purpura, metastatic, or suction.
